messages.subject: Project Drake — COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

I'm pleased to confirm that the acquisition of Tidewell Marina Holdings Limited completed at 3.30pm today. The SPA has been executed in counterparts, the consideration and escrow have been paid, the net debt repaid, and the share transfers approved by the Target board. Gregory Tidewell has resigned as director and signed his consultancy agreement; Eleanor Tidewell has resigned as secretary.

Post-completion we'll attend to stamping (stamp duty £112k), Companies House filings and the change-of-control notifications. Congratulations to the team.

James

—
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
